_comment: Optional keys (video_url, share_times, photo_path) fall back to .env/defaults when omitted. Set video_url/photo_path to "", "none", "off", or "disabled" (or share_times to 0) to disable per account. Use DAILY_CAP in .env to cap sends per account.
name: Main_Account

_comment: Omitted video_url, share_times, and photo_path inherit from .env (including DISABLE_VIDEO / DISABLE_PHOTO) or defaults.
name: Second_Account

_comment: Explicit disable sentinels ("", "none", "off", "disabled") and share_times=0 disable media for this account only.
name: Text_Only_Account
